prompt: What were the circumstances when consent was given? Select all that apply.

options.label: Weapons were drawn, or there was another show of force
An officer said they had a warrant or could search anyway
An officer said they would get a warrant, or implied other consequences, if your client refused
Your client was under arrest or otherwise detained when asked
Your client wasn't told they could refuse
Your client gave in to repeated requests (for example, after first refusing)
Your client was intoxicated, injured, or had difficulty understanding (language, age, mental condition)
The officer asked with a phrase like “do you mind if…”

prompt: Did the search go beyond what your client agreed to? Select all that apply; leave blank if it stayed within the consent.

options.label: Police searched places or containers the consent didn't cover
Police kept searching after your client withdrew or limited consent
